# Seamless Video Looper (moved)

This site moved to https://scintech-dev.github.io/seamless-video-looper/ on 2026-09-23, inside the SciNTech site (https://scintech-dev.github.io/). Every page here redirects to its new address. The current description for language models is https://scintech-dev.github.io/llms.txt.

## Pages

- https://scintech-dev.github.io/seamless-video-looper/ — Product overview.
- https://scintech-dev.github.io/seamless-video-looper/how-it-works/ — How the app finds and blends a loop point.
- https://scintech-dev.github.io/seamless-video-looper/examples/ — Screens from the app.
- https://scintech-dev.github.io/seamless-video-looper/compatibility/ — Android version and media requirements, output format, FAQ.
- https://scintech-dev.github.io/seamless-video-looper/privacy/ — How video and report data are handled, with the full privacy policy at https://scintech-dev.github.io/seamless-video-looper/privacy/#policy.
- https://scintech-dev.github.io/about/ — The priorities behind SciNTech's apps (formerly /values/).
